# OpenGovernment UK

> An open register of the UK state: every public body the official registers know, who each answers to, who owns or controls it, its codes in other registers, and the UK's place in the world. Pilot. Every fact cites its source; anything worked out is labelled.

Identifiers: each body is https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/id/<register key>, for example https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/id/government-organisation:D9. Licence: data OGL v3.0, code MIT, documentation CC BY 4.0.

## Pages

- [Register](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/index.html): search any body; profiles; who answers; changes; data and feeds; ask a question
- [Nation by nation](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/nations.html): each nation's legislature, executive and judiciary
- [UK and the world](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/world.html): international bodies, memberships, treaties, agreements, the Commonwealth, trade and tax agreements, the UK's shares in international financial institutions
- [Org charts](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/orgchart.html): every body in context
- [Funding](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/funding.html): grants, schemes and innovation services
- [Developer hub](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/developers.html): connect, harvest, crosswalks, MCP connector, plugins, test cases, licensing and how to contribute
- [Requirements and design](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/navigator.html): how it is built: needs, requirements, design and checks

## Data

- [Register of the UK state (linked data)](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/data/register.jsonld): Every public body, its parent, identifiers and classification.
- [Register of the UK state (table)](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/data/register.csv): One row per record, with every register code.
- [The UK and the world](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/data/international.jsonld): Memberships of international bodies, the UK body that leads, treaties, agreements, trade agreements in effect and tax treaties.
- [Taxonomies](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/data/taxonomies.skos.jsonld): Types, purposes (UN COFOG), activities, reach, nations (ISO 3166-2:GB), kinds of treaty.
- [Ownership and control (BODS 0.4)](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/bods-0.4.json): Who owns or controls each public body, and the UK's shareholdings in international financial institutions.
- [The register in FollowTheMoney](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/data/register.ftm.json): Public bodies, companies they control, international bodies, links, renames and memberships, for OpenSanctions, OpenAleph and yente.
- [How each source stands](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/data/source-status.json): When each source was read, how often it changes, whether it is current, the parts that could not be read and why, and the expected counts checked on every build.
- [Crosswalks to other standards](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/data/crosswalks.json): Each register field mapped to BODS, FollowTheMoney, ORG and schema.org, Wikidata, org-id and OpenCorporates, every cell checked against the real file or model.
- [OpenAPI description of the published files](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/openapi.json): Every published file as a plain HTTPS GET, for API tools and code generators.
- [Guide for AI agents](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/llms.txt): Where everything is, in plain text, for language models and agents (the llms.txt convention).
- [Provenance of this build](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/data/provenance.jsonld): Sources used, with fingerprints, and the files made.
- [Data package](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/datapackage.json): Every CSV with its fields and licence.
- [Everything in one SQLite file](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/opengovernment-uk.db): All tables, ready for Datasette or any SQLite tool.
- [Who answers for each body](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/accountability.json): Accountability chains, money and owners.
- [Nation by nation](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/nations.json): Each nation's legislature, executive and judiciary.
- [Links between bodies](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/edges.csv): Each parent-child link with its source.
- [Concordance of codes](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/concordance.csv): Every register's code for each body.
- [Accountable owner](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/accountable-owner.csv): Who each body answers to in the end.
- [Public-private partnerships](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/opengovernment-uk/ppp.csv): PFI and PF2 contracts and who pays.
